description:
Southern California Edison Company (SCE) proposes to construct the
Lakeview Substation Project, which includes the 115kB/12kV,56 megavolt
ampere Lakeview Substation with three new 12 kV underground distribution
line getaways and a telecommunications system.  This will require
installation of two new 115 kV substransmission source line to connect
the proposed Lakeview Substation to the existing Valley-Moval 115kV
subtransmission line. One of the line segments would be 1.8 mile in
length and the other 1.5 mile in length.  Environmental Science
Associates (ESA) is being contracted to provide prefiling guidance to
SCE and post-filing CEQA document preparation work on this project. The
contracted project review will most likely develop as a Mitigated
Negative Declaration (MND) rather than as an Environmental Impact Report
(EIR); therefore, the budget for this project review will reflect an
MND.  Nevertheless, the SOW associated with this contract includes MND
and EIR cost breakdowns.  If an EIR is deemed necessary in the course of
the project, then an amendment will be required to reflect the EIR
budget breakdown. The terms of this contract is from February 16, 2010
through June 30, 2012.
